title.narrative: MULTIPHASE PRIMARY HEALTH CARE PROGRAM FOR MANAGING CHRONIC NONCOMMUNICABLE DISEASES
PROGRAMA MULTIFASE DE ATENCIN PRIMARIA DE LA SALUD PARA EL MANEJO DE ENFERMEDADES CRNICAS NO TRANSMISIBLES

description.narrative: El objetivo de esta segunda operacin es contribuir a la reduccin de la morbimortalidad causada por enfermedades crnicas no transmisibles en Argentina, priorizando a la poblacin con cobertura pblica exclusiva. Especficamente, se propone coadyuvar a: (i) jerarquizar el Primer Nivel de Atencin (PNA) como puerta de entrada al sistema de salud; (ii) incrementar el acceso de la poblacin a tamizajes para su clasificacin por riesgo sanitario; e (iii) incrementar el acceso de la poblacin con riesgo sanitario moderado o alto que padece de condiciones crnicas a tratamientos oportunos.

The objective of this second operation is to help reduce morbidity and mortality caused by chronic noncommunicable diseases in Argentina, prioritizing the population with public coverage only. Specifically, this operation proposes to help: (i) prioritize the primary care level as the gateway to the health care system; (ii) increase the population's access to screenings for classification according to health risk; and (iii) increase access to timely treatment for those with moderate or high health risk suffering from chronic conditions.
